snippet.title: Under New Management Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Cogs Inc. is officially under new management! Four brand-new Supervisors have completed orientation and taken charge of the Cog facilities. Toontown needs brave Toons like YOU to enter the revamped facilities and take them down. This management overhaul comes with exciting changes including v2.0 Cog disguises, gag rebalances, and new cosmetics! Check out our website to get the full scoop on the new content. Play NOW!

https://toon.town/newcogs
